info.name: Fetch Energy Merit Order snapshot data for a given date that is 60 days prior to current date.

params.name: startDate
params.description: Any date between 2009-09-01 and 60 days prior to current date (format: yyyy-MM-dd).

items.docs:
Fetch Energy Merit Order snapshot data for Date(startDate (yyyy-MM-dd)) 

The EMMO snapshot data is available 60 days after the date of the snapshot, first available from September 1, 2009. 

The data from 1-Sep-2009 to 1-Sep-2014 is the Merit Order at the 30th min. of the settlement interval. 

The data after 1-Sep-2014 is the last Merit Order of the settlement interval.
